supporting_document: OIML D 11:2013 General requirements for measuring instruments — Environmental conditions
extraction_note: Severities transcribed from OIML R 76-1:2006 Annex A.5 and Annex B. R 76-1 Annex B states that these tests were taken as far as possible from IEC work, taking into account the latest edition of OIML D 11. Where R 76-1 names a severity level, that value governs; D 11 supplies the general method and the IEC reference.

significant_fault.rule: The difference between the weight indication due to the disturbance and the indication without the disturbance shall either not exceed e, or the instrument shall detect and react to a significant fault.

reference_conditions.temperature: Stable within the specified range; the change shall not exceed 1 °C/min during heating and cooling.
reference_conditions.humidity_at_high_temp: Relative humidity shall not exceed 20 g/m³ absolute during weighing tests at the specified high temperature.
reference_conditions.humidity_note: 20 g/m³ corresponds to 39 % RH at 40 °C, 50 % at 35 °C and 66 % at 30 °C, at 1 013.25 hPa.

influence_factors.title: Static temperatures

stages.label: Reference
stages.note: For class I instruments, the mean value of the specified temperature limits.

stages.label: 5 °C
stages.condition: only if the specified low temperature is <= 0 °C

default_range_c.note: Where the manufacturer does not specify a narrower range; see 3.9.2.

influence_factors.soak: 2 hours after the EUT has reached temperature stability, under free air conditions.
influence_factors.procedure: Carry out the weighing test of A.4.4.1 (loading and unloading) at each stage.
notes: For class I instruments, changes in barometric pressure shall be taken into account.

influence_factors.title: Temperature effect on the no-load indication
influence_factors.procedure: Set the instrument to zero, change to the prescribed highest and lowest temperatures and 5 °C if applicable. After stabilisation determine the error of the zero indication. Calculate the change per 1 °C (class I) or per 5 °C (other classes) between any two consecutive temperatures.
notes: Preloading is not allowed before these measurements.
Automatic zero-setting or zero-tracking shall not be in operation.
May be combined with A.5.3.1; errors at zero are then also determined immediately before each temperature change and after the 2 hour stabilisation period.

influence_factors.title: Damp heat, steady state
influence_factors.not_applicable_to: Class I instruments, and class II instruments where e < 1 g.

stages.label: High temperature
stages.hold: two days following temperature and humidity stabilization

tolerance.rule: All functions shall operate as designed. All indications shall be within the mpe.

influence_factors.title: AC mains voltage variation
test_loads: a load between ½ Max and Max

tolerance.rule: All functions shall operate as designed. All indications shall be within the mpe.

notes: For a three-phase supply the variations apply to each phase successively.

influence_factors.title: External or plug-in power supply variation

tolerance.rule: All functions operate as designed or the indication switches off. All indications within the mpe.
All functions operate as designed or the indication switches off. All indications within the mpe.

influence_factors.title: 12 V or 24 V road vehicle battery variation
Span stability
influence_factors.interval_rule: Between ½ day and 10 days, fairly evenly distributed over the total duration.
influence_factors.test_load: Near Max; the same test weights throughout.

disturbances.title: AC mains voltage dips and short interruptions
Electrical fast transients / bursts
applied_separately_to: I/O circuits and communication lines, if any
disturbances.coupling: Capacitive coupling clamp for I/O and communication lines; blocking filters on the mains injection network.

disturbances.title: Surge
disturbances.applicability_rule: Only where the risk of significant influence of surges can be expected from typical installation: outdoor installations, or indoor installations connected to signal lines longer than 30 m or partially or fully installed outside buildings regardless of length. Also applicable to DC powered instruments supplied from DC mains.
disturbances.ac_mains_rule: At least 3 positive and 3 negative surges synchronously with the AC supply voltage at 0°, 90°, 180° and 270°.
disturbances.other_supply_rule: At least three positive and three negative surges.

disturbances.title: Electrostatic discharge

application.direct_contact: Electrode in contact with the EUT, on conductive surfaces.
application.direct_air: Electrode approached to the EUT until a spark occurs, on non-conductive surfaces.
application.indirect: Contact mode to coupling planes mounted in the vicinity of the EUT.

notes: Includes the paint penetration method if appropriate.
An EUT without a ground terminal shall be fully discharged between discharges.

disturbances.title: Immunity to radiated electromagnetic fields
disturbances.frequency_range_note: For instruments having no mains or other I/O ports available so that B.3.6 cannot be applied, the lower limit of the radiation test is 26 MHz.

disturbances.title: Electrical transient conduction along the supply line (12 V and 24 V vehicle supply)
disturbances.note: Severity pulses are specified in the referenced ISO standard; see B.3.7.1 of R 76-1.

disturbances.title: Electrical transient transmission by capacitive and inductive coupling via lines other than supply lines

endurance.title: Endurance
endurance.applies_to: Classes II, III and IIII with Max <= 100 kg
